@deskInvPayerWaitingHead.description: Section heading on the Invoices page › To pay: invoices from trusted services that wait for the user's answer.

@deskInvPayerNeedsHead.description: Section heading on the Invoices page › To pay: invoice payments that need the user (Retry or Cancel payment).

@deskInvPayerReview.description: Button on an invoice row: open the invoice to pay or decline it.

@deskInvPayerView.description: Link on an answered invoice: open its payment in Activity.

@deskInvPayerNoMessage.description: Shown in place of the service's message when the invoice has none.

deskInvPayerDropped: {count, plural, =1{1 message from a sender you do not trust was ignored.} other{{count} messages from senders you do not trust were ignored.}}

@deskInvPayerDropped.description: Quiet line on the Invoices page › To pay: invoices from senders not on the trusted list were dropped unread. Never more detail.

@deskInvPayerTrustService.description: Link: open Settings › Receiving to add a service allowed to send invoices.

@deskInvPayerYourInvoiceAddress.description: Link: open Settings › Receiving where the invoice address is shown.

@deskInvPayerEmptyTitle.description: Empty state title of Requests › To pay.

deskInvPayerEmptyText: When a service you trust bills you, the invoice appears here. Nothing is paid until you approve it.

@deskInvPayerEmptyText.description: Empty state text of Requests › To pay.

deskInvPayerNotDeliveredTitle: Your payment to {service} was not delivered

@deskInvPayerNotDeliveredTitle.description: Notice on To pay: an approved invoice payment did not reach the relay. service is the user's label for the service.

deskInvPayerNotDeliveredText: It is signed and kept on this device; the funds stay locked. Retry sends it again without a second approval.

@deskInvPayerNotDeliveredText.description: Notice text for a payment that was not delivered.

@deskInvPayerWithdrawnTitle.description: Notice on To pay: the service withdrew the invoice after the user paid. service is the user's label.

deskInvPayerWithdrawnText: The payment may never reach the chain. Cancel it to unlock your funds.

@deskInvPayerWithdrawnText.description: Notice text: a paid invoice was withdrawn; the user may cancel the payment.

deskInvPayerPastTtlTitle: Your payment to {service} is not on chain

@deskInvPayerPastTtlTitle.description: Notice on To pay: the invoice's time passed and the payment is neither in the pool nor on the chain. service is the user's label.

deskInvPayerPastTtlText: Its time passed and the network has not seen it. Cancel it to unlock your funds.

@deskInvPayerPastTtlText.description: Notice text for a paid invoice past its time and not on chain.

@deskInvPayerCancelPayment.description: Button: cancel an invoice payment that did not complete, unlocking the funds.

@deskInvPayerSafetyTitle.description: Warning panel title on Review invoice: a fake invoice must not be paid.

deskInvPayerSafetyText: An invoice never adds money to your wallet. Approving it sends money out.

@deskInvPayerSafetyText.description: Warning panel text on Review invoice.

deskInvPayerSameBillTitle: You paid {service} the same amount {ago} ago

@deskInvPayerSameBillTitle.description: Warning on Review invoice: a paid invoice from the same service for the same amount is recent. ago is a duration like '3 h 10 min' or '25 min'.

deskInvPayerSameBillText: Check that this is a new bill before you pay it.

@deskInvPayerAgoHours.description: A past duration in hours and minutes, used inside another sentence, e.g. '3 h 10 min'.

@deskInvPayerAgoMinutes.description: A past duration in minutes, used inside another sentence, e.g. '25 min'.

@deskInvPayerFee.description: Label: the network fee the user pays on top of the invoice.

@deskInvPayerBalanceAfter.description: Label: spendable balance left after paying.

deskInvPayerMessageCaption: Written by the service. Your wallet does not check it.

@deskInvPayerMessageCaption.description: Caption under the service's message on Review invoice: the text is untrusted.

@deskInvPayerPaysTo.description: Label: the address the payment goes to (stored in the trusted list).

@deskInvPayerTrustedSince.description: The service's label and when the user added it to trusted services, e.g. 'Coffee Roasters, trusted since 2 Sep 2026'.

@deskInvPayerExpires.description: Label: time left before the invoice expires.

@deskInvPayerLockHeight.description: Label: the block before which the payment cannot be included. Always None for a valid invoice.

@deskInvPayerLockNone.description: Value of Lock height: the payment is not locked to a later block.

@deskInvPayerShort.description: Reason Approve is disabled: the spendable balance is below amount plus fee.

deskInvPayerShortText: You need {total} EPIC spendable; you have {spendable} EPIC. Funds still confirming count once they have 3 confirmations.

@deskInvPayerShortText.description: Text under the not-enough-funds reason. total and spendable are formatted amounts.

@deskInvPayerNodeDownTitle.description: Reason Approve is disabled: the wallet's node cannot be reached.

deskInvPayerNodeDownText: The wallet cannot check your funds, so it cannot pay. Approve works again once the node answers; you can pick another node in Settings › Node.

@deskInvPayerNodeDownText.description: Text under the node-down reason. The wallet never switches node by itself.

deskInvPayerPaid: This invoice is paid. Nothing more can be paid on it.

@deskInvPayerPaid.description: Read-only Review invoice: the invoice was already approved and paid.

deskInvPayerDeclinedText: You declined this invoice. Nothing was paid.

@deskInvPayerDeclinedText.description: Read-only Review invoice: the user declined it.

@deskInvPayerBack.description: Button on a read-only Review invoice page: go back to Requests › To pay.

@deskInvPayerApproveTitle.description: Title of the approve dialog. amount and fee are formatted numbers; service is the user's label.

deskInvPayerApproveText: {total} EPIC leaves your wallet. Enter the wallet password to approve.

@deskInvPayerApproveText.description: Text of the approve dialog. total is the formatted amount plus fee.

@deskInvPayerPassword.description: Label of the password field in the approve dialog.

@deskInvPayerWrongPassword.description: Field error in the approve dialog.

@deskInvPayerEnterPassword.description: Field error in the approve dialog when the password is empty.

@deskInvPayerPay.description: Main button of the approve dialog.

@deskInvPayerCancel.description: Button: close a dialog without doing anything.

deskInvPayerNodeDownPay: The node is not answering. Nothing was paid.

@deskInvPayerNodeDownPay.description: Error in the approve dialog: the pay call failed because the node is down.

deskInvPayerAlreadyAnswered: This invoice was already answered. Nothing more was paid.

@deskInvPayerAlreadyAnswered.description: Error in the approve dialog: the invoice was paid or declined elsewhere (double pay prevented).

deskInvPayerCannotPay: This invoice cannot be paid. Nothing was paid.

@deskInvPayerCannotPay.description: Error in the approve dialog for any other refusal (amount mismatch, invalid).

@deskInvPayerNotDeliveredToast.description: Toast after Approve when the relay did not take the payment.

deskInvPayerNotDeliveredToastText: The Epicbox server is not answering. Retry it under Invoices › Pay; no second approval.

@deskInvPayerNotDeliveredToastText.description: Toast text after Approve when the relay did not take the payment.

deskInvPayerRetryFailedText: The Epicbox server is not answering. The payment stays signed on this device.

@deskInvPayerCancelTitle.description: Title of the cancel payment dialog.

deskInvPayerCancelText: Cancelling unlocks your funds here. The service still holds your signed payment, so it could still complete until these funds are spent again.

@deskInvPayerCancelText.description: Cancel payment dialog text (decision D-2): cancelling is local; the signed payment can still complete.

@deskInvPayerCancelWho.description: Which payment the cancel dialog is about. amount is formatted.

@deskInvPayerKeepPayment.description: Button: close the cancel dialog and keep the payment.

deskInvPayerOnItsWay: Already on its way: it cannot be cancelled.

@deskInvPayerOnItsWay.description: Error: the payment is in the pool or on chain.

deskInvPayerCannotCheck: Cannot check the network now; try again when the node is reachable.

@deskInvPayerCannotCheck.description: Error: cancelling needs the node, which is not answering.

@deskInvPayerCancelled.description: Toast after a payment was cancelled.

@deskInvPayerCancelledText.description: Toast text after a payment was cancelled.

@deskInvPayerDeclined.description: Toast after the user declined an invoice; it leaves To pay at once.

@deskInvPayerSpendToSelf.description: Checkbox on the Cancel payment confirm (decision D-2): after the cancel, move the unlocked coins to this wallet itself.

deskInvPayerSpendToSelfHelp: Makes the cancel final: the service's signed copy can no longer complete. Costs a network fee.

@deskInvPayerSpendToSelfHelp.description: Help under the Spend them to myself now checkbox.

deskInvPayerSpentText: Your funds are unlocked and moved within this wallet. The cancel is final.

@deskInvPayerSpentText.description: Toast text after a cancel whose coins were spent to the wallet itself.

deskInvPayerSpendFailedText: Your funds are unlocked, but moving them did not work. The cancel is not final yet.

@deskInvPayerSpendFailedText.description: Toast text after a cancel whose spend to the wallet itself failed.

deskInvPayerLocked: This invoice cannot be paid: it is locked until a later block. Nothing was paid.

@deskInvPayerLocked.description: Review: the invoice's kernel is locked above the chain's tip (LEPIC refuses it and stores nothing).

deskInvPayerRelayDownPay: The Epicbox server is not answering. Nothing was paid.

@deskInvPayerRelayDownPay.description: Approve dialog: the Epicbox server could not be reached before anything was signed or stored.

@deskInvPayerStalledTitle.description: Notice on To pay: a paid invoice whose payment has not reached the network a while after paying. service is the user's label for the service.

deskInvPayerStalledText: Not delivered: it has not reached the network yet, and the funds stay locked. Send again sends it once more without a second approval.

@deskInvPayerStalledText.description: Notice text and Invoice block text for a stalled invoice payment. Send again is a button.
